name: Ground Truth
description: Compares every link and direct node against its own past and reports the ones that quietly lost signal — water in a connector, a shifted mast, a tree that grew. Reads the mapper's own history; writes nothing.

stats_db_path.description: Where the mapper keeps its history. Opened read-only; nothing is ever written to it. Change this only if your web root is elsewhere (Docker, custom install).

baseline_days.description: How far back 'how it used to be' reaches (days)

recent_days.description: How recent 'how it is now' is (days)

drop_db.description: Report a link only after it has lost at least this many dB

min_samples.description: Measurements required in each window before a verdict is offered

include_nodes.description: Also check the nodes your own radio hears directly (zero hops)

default_enabled.description: Run the check as soon as the map loads
